title: A page's object-form thank-you panel has no translation key
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibx5r5nhDMwpRs4SL6D

Filing gate: ③ should-fix S1 of contract review 6528389425 on PR #28195 (#28004), filed by the seat so the gap does not stay "noted, not filed". ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the lane and grade.
Reach: any page that embeds an `object-form` with a `thank-you` submit behavior. The showcase's `new-project-wizard` page (`examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/new-project-wizard.page.ts` L68) authors one; its "Project created" panel stays in the authored language in every locale.
Reader who acts: `domain:spec` (the translation key and the `translatePage` overlay), then lint and the extractor, as in PR #28195.
Duplicate search: `search_issues` "object-form submitBehavior thank-you translation page component" → #28004 (the form view's own panel, landing in PR #28195), not this.

## Observed (once PR #28195 is on `main`)

- A form view's thank-you `title` / `message` are translatable at `objects.OBJECT._views.VIEW.submitBehavior.title` / `.message` and overlaid by `translateView`.
- `ObjectFormPropsSchema.submitBehavior` (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` ≈L7076, the page `object-form` block, the form view's own member by reference) has no key under `pages.<name>` and nothing in `translatePage` overlays it.

## Wanted

- A translation address for the page `object-form` component's thank-you `title` / `message`, overlaid by `translatePage` with the same override rules `translateFormSubmitBehavior` uses (one comparison, no second copy). Whether the address lives under `pages.<name>` or under the bound object (the `_sections` precedent at `translation.zod.ts` ≈L530) is the card thread's design call; it names the alternative.
- The extractor scaffolds the keys, lint knows them, and the showcase page's panel gains its zh-CN strings.

Dedupe words: page object-form thank-you translation, submitBehavior page i18n, translatePage object-form.

Links back: #28004, PR #28195, review 6528389425.

Blocked-by: #28195
